participants.name: Jonathan

persona.name: Jonathan
persona.personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.

participants.private_seed: Every year the development money is voted through as though it were the whole cost, and the running side turns up unfunded twelve months later. Before anything is committed I would like to know what this budget can actually build and what any of it would earn back.

participants.name: Shizue

persona.name: Shizue
persona.personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Through her years of life experience, Shizue has come to understand the importance of living peacefully with others.

participants.private_seed: Approval has never been the hard part here; things break in the second year, once the arrangement turns out to rest on a department or an outside body that never really signed up to it. I went looking for where our recent starts came apart.

participants.name: Shion

persona.name: Shion
persona.personality: Shion is very confident and often acts calmly and calculatingly. On the surface, he is quiet and good at observing others' movements, but deep down he wants to be the center of attention. He sometimes shows a slightly challenging attitude toward those around him and tends to want to do things at his own pace. In addition, he does not show his emotions much and is the type of person who judges things coldly and logically. The occasional smile he shows hides a charm that surprises those around him.

participants.private_seed: We have started and quietly buried enough initiatives that nobody can now say which of them ever changed anything for a patient. It seemed worth reading what the earlier attempts actually produced before we add another to the pile.

participants.name: Kenji

persona.name: Kenji
persona.personality: Kenji is curious and actively takes on challenges. He values his friends and enjoys communicating with those around him. Although he can be a little clumsy at times, he is always positive and never abandons those in need. He is easygoing and well-liked by those around him.

participants.private_seed: Anything new has to fit into a day that is already full — the rooms, the approach roads, the booking screens everything must pass through. What worries me is less the merit of the idea than whether this place could absorb it without seizing up.

participants.name: Midori

persona.name: Midori
persona.personality: Midori has a calm and kind personality. She is friendly to everyone and listens to the concerns and problems of those around her, offering reliable advice. She can be a little shy, often acting reserved with people she meets for the first time, but once she opens up, she shows her bright and energetic side. She loves cooking and has a domestic side, but she also has a spirit of adventure and enjoys trying new things. She values balance in both her work and personal life and places importance on harmony with those around her.

participants.private_seed: Rosters are where every new program eventually lands, and the teams it lands on are rarely the ones that asked for it. Pressure sits so differently between one clinical group and the next that I wanted the staffing records in front of me.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a care program for a regional hospital's development budget. A five-member review panel of clinicians and hospital administrators considers the program proposals submitted by departments. One program will be established with this year's development budget. Participants: Jonathan, Shizue, Shion, Kenji and Midori. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- This year's development allocation in the ledger
- Regional fund tariffs by contact location
- Board minutes on a jointly run clinic
- Data agreements with outside surgeries
- Readmission figures during the call-back trial
- Visit completion on the shared nursing round
- Rooms, parking and shuttle coverage
- What the booking system records
- Ward nursing vacancies and agency cover
- Therapy and midwifery staffing review

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Jonathan, Shion, Midori, Kenji and Shizue. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
